scope: Act 1 enemy-mechanics facts used by VEDA encounter verification. These are not strategy rules.

claims.statement: Acid Slime (M) has 28–32 HP at Ascension 0 and cannot Split. Its moves include Corrosive Spit for 7 damage plus a Slimed, Lick for 1 Weak, and Tackle for 10 damage.
Only Acid Slime (L), Spike Slime (L), and Slime Boss have Split; when at or below half HP they split into two smaller Slimes with their current HP.
The three Act 1 Elite encounters are Gremlin Nob, Lagavulin, and Sentries; elite reward confirmation includes a relic, 25–35 Gold, and a card reward.
